scripts/twin_state_integrity.py.explanation: equivalence needs a pipeline run's chain tables; outputs/pipeline/ run directories are deliberately not committed (owner decision), so a fresh clone has none until scripts/run_pipeline.py is executed

scripts/verify_protected_artifacts.py --.explanation: (1) the clone at Commit A still carries the 2026-11-06 frozen manifest, which hashes the pre-Phase-B tests/test_figures.py; the re-issued manifest is scheduled for Commit B. (2) head_ok compares HEAD against the exact set {78ee339, 938d514}; see open_issue

scripts/verify_protected_artifacts.py --.content_checks: all pass (figure_release_manifest n=107 bad=[] with the re-issued manifest in the working tree; twin ok; opssat ok; esa_adb ok; g5d ok)

tests/test_figures.py::test_manifest_git.assertion: HEAD aeefac2bd932 is neither the manifest's commit nor an approved checkpoint

open_issue.statement: APPROVED_HEADS in scripts/verify_protected_artifacts.py (used by the verifier's head_ok and by tests/test_figures.py) accepts only the exact commits 78ee339 and 938d514. Every new commit on the branch, including each of the four planned release commits, therefore fails head_ok and the figure test until its hash is added in a later commit; the final commit can never contain its own hash.
open_issue.impact: no artifact drift: all content hashes verify; the failure is the HEAD-membership predicate only
open_issue.recommended_fix: accept HEAD when it is an approved head OR a descendant of one (git merge-base --is-ancestor), in both the verifier and the test; this matches the test's existing 'committed in a descendant' invariant and keeps the protection against unrelated branches
open_issue.decision: owner's: the fix changes two tracked files already in Commit A and would have to go into Commit B or a dedicated commit

conclusion: Fresh-clone LFS retrieval and twin-state integrity verification PASSED. The re-emitted twin state is byte-identical in clone, source and recorded digest, and the console reads it from the clone root as the primary verified source.
